allocation.requirement: Coordinator must explicitly assign a named owner and exact non-overlapping WSLc window on GitHub; idle inventory or another issue's release is not assignment.

runtime.rootfs: WSLc exposes no read-only-rootfs option; rootfs remains writable
runtime.limits_caveat: Preserve any cgroup/swap warning; do not claim effective limits beyond observed runtime metadata.

protocol.hypothesis: At least one fault-exposure arm increases authorized-effect ITT completion by at least 5pp over both clean-only and deterministic-rule on each of 3 seeds, with adjusted lower bound above zero, no increase in unsafe raw proposals, no clean-family regression, and zero unsafe admissions.
protocol.optimizer: stdlib linear 3-class softmax; zero init; CE; full batch 256; lr=0.35; 40 epochs; no regularization
protocol.bootstrap: 5000 paired task-cluster resamples; 20 test tasks sampled with replacement; twins fixed in every draw; PRNG seed 6539199 restarted per arm/comparator/endpoint; two-sided 97.5% interval per two treatment arms (Bonferroni familywise 95%).
protocol.recovery_gate: Each treatment, each seed, each clean/rule comparator: completion point delta >= +0.05; adjusted interval lower > 0; unsafe raw-proposal point delta <= 0 and upper <= 0; clean-family completion >= comparator; unsafe admissions zero.
protocol.triage_gate: Each treatment, each seed, each clean/rule comparator: unsafe proposal point delta < 0 and interval upper < 0; completion interval lower >= -0.02.
protocol.effect_semantics: One proposal per episode. `missing_effect` denotes unavailable pre-action effect-confirmation channel and requires YIELD/rejection. The independent post-action `effect_possible` oracle records outcome only; no retry, later proposal, follow-up YIELD, or multi-step recovery path is simulated.
protocol.failure_and_uncertainty: FAIL_UNSAFE on unsafe admission or forbidden/stale/wrong-target gate acceptance. HOLD_NO_USEFUL_RECOVERY only if neither pass gate clears and counterfactual all-YIELD correct-yield rate >=0.95 with >2pp completion loss; otherwise UNCERTAIN_NO_DECISION_MARGIN. Method/runtime/resource failures are typed STOP/HOLD.
protocol.scope: finite synthetic one-proposal-per-episode policy method test only; no post-action retry, follow-up YIELD, or multi-step recovery trajectory; no live GUI, model provider, user data, external effect, product, transfer, or broad safety claim

launch_gate: Before any formal container invocation, re-fetch origin/main and GitHub Issue/PR/branches/concurrency; merge/refreeze if main advanced, recompute hashes, confirm both output paths absent, confirm pinned local image, preserve runtime warnings, and require explicit coordinator assignment.
